prompt: A single small floating balance scale on the open sea, seen from slightly above: one thin upright post rising out of the water, and on top of it one straight horizontal beam with two arms of equal length, one to each side. From the end of each arm hangs a short straight line down to a small round buoy floating on the water. The two buoys sit at clearly different heights: the left buoy rides lower, half sunk in the water, the right buoy rides higher, lifted on the surface, so the beam tilts gently. Above the higher right buoy, a thin mast carries one little plain pennant flag filled with flat amber ochre #C27A1A, a warm golden brown. The post, the beam, the lines and the buoys are drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading; only the pennant is amber. The buoys are plain and blank. From each buoy, small concentric ripples spread across the water surface, drawn as fine engraved off-white lines in the water itself: wide flattened ellipses seen in perspective, much wider than tall, fading into the wave lines and dying out well before the left third of the image. Richly detailed engraved nautical chart style, like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the sea built from many layers of fine wave lines and hatching, line density increasing towards the deep water to give depth, tonal bands from deep cerulean at the bottom to lighter cerulean at the top, bathymetric contour lines with small depth soundings drawn as tiny dots, subtle foam strokes and a few glints of light on the crests. Every wave is drawn as visible engraved line work, like a steel engraving, never painted, never smooth. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no gradient, no pans, no weights, no person, no hand, no text, no letters, no numbers, no digits, no watermark, no horizon, no sky, no border, no frame. The engraved sea fills the whole wide image edge to edge. The balance is medium-small and sits in the right half of the image with water all around it; the entire left third of the image is completely calm open water with nothing in it, only quiet engraved wave lines. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of amber ochre #C27A1A on the pennant only.
